status: frozen before any evidence run (commit recorded in the worklog); amendments only as labelled appended entries
question: Within a qualified sharp multi-bounce GM1 workload, can a source-independent geometry/material-dependent transport relation preserve the necessary directional information at practical lifecycle cost, and is the remaining bottleneck relation discovery or repeated physical transport evaluation?
hypothesis: A reusable geometry/material-dependent directional transport relation can capture the sharp path families missed by the deployed receiver-side sampling state without requiring exhaustive or source-dependent transport reconstruction. Falsified for the tested workload if R1 fails the sharp-family fidelity criteria where the source-dependent comparator or a converged relation of the same representation passes, if it needs source information, or if its construction cost is not practical (verdict mapping).
frozen_inputs: WL84 ER closures (experiments/ecro86/data/mats86.npz, sha256 in mats86.json); WL86 code (experiments/ecro86) and WL87 code (experiments/gm1_explicit87) imported unchanged; WL86 references / masks of E2 (~/rest_ecro86); WL87 tables (~/rest_gm187) for the integration test; WL86 / WL87 thresholds
contract: As WL86 / WL87: b = S_ER(e + C_G b); table B = L2 + L3 + L4 + L5 (2..5 events per patch x outgoing bin), read by the unchanged WL86 LOW + lookup renderer (3..6 camera events); q = L1 (WL87 qtable, unchanged) not in B; no renormalisation, clamping or energy correction
workload_family: WL86 room; box A becomes the moving glossy mover G with the frozen S1 ER state (bit-identical copy; the physical P reference uses the S1 layered descriptor); box B Lambert; panel S1, sphere S2, floor B, Lambert walls unchanged. Only frozen, qualified ER materials. Rigid edits of G only.

w_rule.geometry: scene86.geom_ok at T0 and T1 and light_ok for the workload light and LMIX88 / LSPOT88

regions.definition: masks88.py docstring: stationary / A as WL86; C_ss = stationary broad receivers in a two-specular-reflection footprint (S1 -> S1) present in exactly one of T0 / T1; R_mirror = stationary panel pixels whose WL86 mirror cone sees G or a stationary point whose G-involving footprint status changes (fraction >= sc_min); D / E as WL86 excluding C_ss / R_mirror. Geometry / visibility only.

peaked_rule.definition: material m is a peaked sender if the median over the 64 bin-centre incident directions of max_bo fbar_m(w)[bo] / (a_m(w) / pi) > threshold (= kappa, the receiver-uniform rays per incident bin); Lambert = 1. Dev values (material-only): B 4.93, S1 37.95, S2 16.13

matched_variant.note: half the receiver-uniform rays (first 4 of each bin, reweighted) + the same area proposal: traced rays close to the R0 budget of 650,240

relation.R1: rel88.py docstring (SAM): receiver-uniform (deployed state) + sender-area proposal for every front-facing (flat receiver, peaked sender patch) pair, m stratified samples, balance heuristic over the first-hit-peaked term; area samples scatter with the dense 16 x 16 fbar table (ER receivers) or rho / pi; curved receivers keep the uniform proposal only; selective update: u rays by the WL86 dirty rule, pairs rebuilt, area samples re-traced for new / moved pairs and segments meeting the old / new moved volume

stage0.tests: tests88.py: T_WL87 (R0 = WL87 EXP on E2 T1 <= 1e-4), T_REDUCE (R1 with m = 0 equals R0 <= 1e-6), T_PEAKED (rule selects S1 / S2 / G only), T_CULL (no uniform hit on a peaked sender outside the pair list), T_ER (sample / eval / pdf / uniform albedo), T_FRAMES, T_DENSE (dense albedo median <= 2 %), T_UNBIASED (known field L = 1 on peaked patches: flux ratios R1 within 1 %, R0 within 2 % of a pure area estimator; R1 not worse than R0 + 0.01), T_ZERO_LIN_NONNEG, T_SOURCE_INDEPENDENT, T_DETERMINISTIC, T_EDIT (null, selective = full, move-and-return), T_FAMILY (render_fam = pt86 estimator, classes sum to h). Any failure: STOPPED_INVALID_COMPARISON

qualification.note: independent qualification partition, used only for admission

references.common_random_numbers: T0 and T1 share seeds; replicas independent
references.estimator: pt86 cam (ER: pt88.render_fam = same estimator + family channels)

qualification.criteria: analyze88.wqualify: Q1 A, Q2 Bset (WL86); Q3 C_ss: pixels, mean |change| >= C_min and >= snr x floor, the >= 2-S1-vertex family (H2) carries >= family_share_min of the absolute change of h and its change >= snr x floor; Q4 R_mirror: pixels, change, G-involving families (H1G + H2G) >= family_share_min of the change of h; Q5 D (WL86 Q4); Q6 H share (WL86); Q7 projected final reference uncertainty; Q8 projected final REF-ER noise of h in C_ss and R_mirror <= sharp_ref_noise_max (one third of the F2 threshold). Candidates tried in w_order; the first admitted is W1. None admitted: STOPPED_WORKLOAD_UNQUALIFIED (Task A on the historical E2 still runs)

thresholds.note: WL86 F1-F4 unchanged; F2 / F3 applied prospectively to the new sharp regions C_ss and R_mirror (sharp-family fidelity / edit-response criteria)

stage1.target_identity: R0_INF (64 pooled R0 realizations), R1_INF (16 pooled R1 realizations, m = 16) and C3U_INF (sender-uniform, kappa_s 64 x 4 per order) estimate the same discrete operator: region signed difference <= tol + noise and field flux ratio within tol, else the comparison changed its physical target
stage1.classification: R1: SUFFICIENT (F1, F2 incl. C_ss / R_mirror, F3 all pass and not worse than R0 beyond noise in any region) / SHARP_SUFFICIENT_OTHER_FAIL / INSUFFICIENTLY_RESOLVED (all failures within 1.5 x noise) / INSUFFICIENT / NUMERICALLY_INVALID
stage1.limit_attribution: per sharp region at T1: oracle table fails -> output representation; converged relations fail while the oracle passes -> relation (intermediate-order) discretisation; C3 passes while R1 fails -> source-dependent placement
stage1.task_A: factor differences (signed and E_H) in E2 C and W1 sharp regions: C3 - C3U (power allocation), C3U - C3UR (fresh relation per order), C3UR - R0D (sender vs receiver placement at equal rays and equal dense quadrature), R0D - R0 (scattering quadrature), POOL4 - R0 (4x work), R0F - R0 (independent relation per order), RS0 - R0 (sender projection in the first gather)

stage2.heldout: W2 (held-out edit, own light) at T0 / T1; W1 T1 with LMIX88 (two coloured lights) and LSPOT88 (cone, never used): relations built once per geometry and reused without reconstruction for every source; F4 on stationary, F2 on sharp regions with >= 1000 pixels

stage3.rules: run alone on the GPU; warm numbers exclude first-call compilation (each operation executed once untimed); per-edit lifecycle A geometry, B relation discovery, C coefficients, D source projection, E application, F transfer, G first-frame extra; quality matched by log-log interpolation only; meaningful advantage 1.25x

renders.note: common random numbers across arms of a configuration

verdict_mapping.text: analyze88.verdict: WORKLOAD_QUALIFICATION (admitted); PHYSICAL_CORRECTNESS (tests + target identity); SHARP_RELATION_INFORMATION_SUFFICIENCY (R1 class + realization pass fraction >= 0.9 for SUPPORTED; CONDITIONAL if sharp regions pass or the paired realization improvement over R0 has a 95 % interval below 0); SOURCE_INDEPENDENT_REUSE (no source input, digest constant across sources, held-out source gates); DYNAMIC_EDIT_VALIDITY (null / selective = full / move-and-return, F3, W2 gates); RELATION_CONSTRUCTION_ECONOMICS and OPERATOR_APPLICATION_ECONOMICS (R1 / R0 per-edit ratio <= 1.25 SUPPORTED, <= 2 CONDITIONAL); QUALITY_MATCHED_END_TO_END_ECONOMICS (eligible only with sufficiency and source independence; SUPPORTED if R1 beats R0 >= 1.25x or reaches a sharp level R0 does not, without losing any, and beats PT >= 1.25x at every reached level); REPRESENTATION_SCALABILITY (log-log exponent of R1 build time and pair count vs N <= 1.25 SUPPORTED, <= 1.6 CONDITIONAL); GM1_ARCHITECTURE_IMPLICATION: outcomes A-F of the brief (stage4) - A relation feasibility, B evaluation-dominated (application + source projection >= 50 % of the per-edit cost), C discovery-dominated (relation update >= 50 %), D source-independence limit (C3 passes a sharp region R1 fails), E representation limit (a sharp region where R1, C3 and every converged relation fail), F mixed / indeterminate. Not an architecture selection.

scope: One room family, rigid edits of one S1 glossy mover, frozen ER materials S1 / S2 / B / Lambert, point and cone lights, 512^2 camera, 64-bin patch tables. No learning, no H-P, no GM2. Historical E2 calibration only.
